text:
emma: Quick idea 1: run a two-session "Inference Field Day" for platform engineers. Session A = "Cost & Throughput Labs" (hands-on benchmarks + quantization), Session B = "Resilience & Routing" (failovers, canaries, multi-model routing). Keep each to 45 mins + 15 Q&A. Aim for late May. Thoughts?

mina: Love the hands-on angle. Suggest we build two tiny labs attendees can run post-webinar (k8s + small CLI) so they get immediate value. I can author the lab steps and a trimmed docker-compose for local runs.

jon: Ops / recording note: we need a rehearsal with the Dedicated pool reserved and a dry run of traffic replay. Also request 10min segment showing how latency changes when you flip batching/quant. I'll own the infra checklist.

carla: I'll draft two case studies: one startup trimming unit cost with quantization, one mid-market using routing for graceful degradation. Short 1-slide takeaways each. Can have customer quotes anonymized.

isha: For lead capture and routing, propose tags: `field-day.session=A|B` and `interest=cost|resilience`. Also we should add `demo_requested=true` when someone clicks the trial CTA. Nurture flow: session-specific follow-up + bench whitepaper.

emma: Example tagging config to share with sales/dev:
```
marketing_tags:
  event: inference_field_day
  session: "A|B"
  interest_taxonomy: [cost, resilience]
  lead_props: [utm_source, campaign, demo_requested]
```
Rehearsal cadence: full run 1 week prior, host tech check 40m before show, recording test 15m prior. Host script will include explicit failure demo lines.

mina: Lab content note: keep the commands copy-paste friendly. Example CLI snippet for the lab README:
```
# run benchmark profile
redwood-cli generate --model redwood-medium-q8 --tokens 1024 --profile burst
# switch routing policy
redwood-cli route set --policy fallback-to-smaller --threshold 150ms
```
I'll push the lab repo by Wed.

jon: I'll coordinate with @deploy-bot to create calendar holds and reserve a small Dedicated pool for rehearsals. Also will add a "failover cue" to the runbook: exact phrasing for host when toggling model.

carla: Case studies ready Fri, will attach blurbs + two screenshots (cost dashboard + latency graph).

deploy-bot: calendar: created 2 placeholder events for Inference Field Day sessions. Reminders 48h and 30m for hosts.

emma: Nice. Action items: emma = landing + RSVP page by Tue, mina = lab repo Wed, jon = infra runbook + rehearsal reservations Mon, carla = case studies Fri, isha = nurture flow + tag spec Tue. I'll send invites & a short host script now. :rocket:
